plugins.zh: 共同層：所有角色都啟用
plugins.en: Common layer, enabled for every role

roles.en: Project with both app and web

skills.zh: 把設計稿截圖對應到專案的設計 token，產出 token 對應表與狀態矩陣，再交給 requirements。
skills.en: Map design screenshots to the project's design tokens; produce a token table and state matrix, then hand off to requirements.
skills.whenEn: Only when a design file exists.

whens.zh: 有設計稿，要對應到專案的設計 token
whens.en: You have a design file to map onto the project's design tokens

whens.zh: 沒有設計稿，直接寫任務文件
whens.en: No design file; go straight to the task document

skills.zh: 先讀既有文件並判斷可信度，再翻原始碼；產出含影響範圍、風險、任務與驗證方式的任務文件。
skills.en: Read existing docs and judge their reliability, then read the source; produce a task document with impact, risks, tasks and verification.
skills.whenZh: 開發前，把模糊需求變成可實作的文件。
skills.whenEn: Before coding, to turn a vague request into an implementable document.

whens.zh: 需求要變成別人讀完就能實作的文件
whens.en: A request must become a document someone can implement from

whens.zh: 需求模糊、只有人能決定
whens.en: The request is ambiguous and only a person can decide

whens.zh: 有設計稿要先對應 token
whens.en: A design file needs mapping first

skills.zh: 反覆追問，只問查不到、只有人能決定的事，直到需求沒有模糊地帶。
skills.en: Keep asking, only about what cannot be looked up and only a person can decide, until nothing is ambiguous.
skills.whenZh: 需求模糊時，由 requirements 叫用。
skills.whenEn: When a request is ambiguous; called by requirements.

whens.zh: 需求有多種解讀，會改變影響範圍
whens.en: The request has several readings that change the scope

whens.zh: 想檢驗自己的想法
whens.en: You want your own idea stress-tested

skills.zh: 測試先行：先約定介面，一個測試配一段實作，紅燈、綠燈、重構。
skills.en: Test first: agree on the interface, one test per slice of implementation; red, green, refactor.
skills.whenZh: 新程式、有測試基礎的程式。
skills.whenEn: For new code or code that already has a test setup.

whens.zh: 寫新程式，想先約定介面再實作
whens.en: Writing new code and want the interface agreed before implementing

whens.zh: bug 卡住、重現不了
whens.en: A bug is stuck and won't reproduce

skills.zh: 先做出能穩定重現的回饋迴路，再提出可被推翻的假設逐一驗證。
skills.en: Build a reliable reproduction loop first, then test falsifiable hypotheses one at a time.
skills.whenEn: When a bug is stuck or hard to reproduce.

whens.zh: bug 難以重現、試了幾次都沒修好
whens.en: A bug is hard to reproduce and fixes keep failing

skills.zh: 在寫程式前，讓全新 context 的 reviewer 只拿產物和契約，對高風險決定做對抗式複查。
skills.en: Before writing code, let a fresh-context reviewer attack a high-risk decision using only the artifact and its contract.
skills.whenZh: 任務文件標了高風險決定時。
skills.whenEn: When the task document flags a high-risk decision.

whens.zh: 任務文件標了高風險決定，寫程式之前
whens.en: The task document flags a high-risk decision; before coding

whens.zh: 要動到多個風險區塊的複雜需求
whens.en: Complex work touching several risky areas

skills.zh: 把網頁畫面與 Flutter Web 並排量測，逐個元素比對座標、字型與狀態。
skills.en: Measure a web page side by side with its Flutter Web original; compare coordinates, fonts and states per element.
skills.whenZh: 網頁重寫、需要和舊畫面一致時。
skills.whenEn: When rewriting a screen and it must match the original.

whens.zh: 網頁重寫，要和原本的 Flutter Web 畫面一致
whens.en: Rewriting a screen that must match the Flutter Web original

skills.zh: 自動判斷技術棧，套用對應清單審查；同時另派 subagent 對照任務文件，規範與 spec 兩軸分開列。
skills.en: Detect the tech stack and review against its checklist; a second subagent checks the diff against the task document, reported separately.

whens.zh: 開發完成，要審規範也要對照任務文件
whens.en: Implementation is done; review standards and check against the task document

whens.zh: 需求複雜，要多家模型一起審
whens.en: Complex work that needs several models to review

skills.zh: stack-review 呼叫的深度審查 subagent。
skills.en: The deep-review subagent that stack-review calls.

whens.zh: 由 stack-review 自動派出，不用自己叫
whens.en: Dispatched by stack-review; you don't call it yourself

skills.zh: 複雜需求用：外部 CLI 實作，多家模型分別 review，取代一般的開發與審查兩步。
skills.en: For complex work: an external CLI implements and several models review, replacing the normal build and review steps.
skills.whenZh: 需求複雜、已有需求文件時，手動叫用。
skills.whenEn: For complex work with a requirements document; invoked manually.

whens.zh: 需求複雜，且已有需求文件
whens.en: Complex work with a requirements document in hand

whens.zh: 一般大小的任務
whens.en: A normal-sized task

skills.zh: 任務文件標為已完成、更新變更記錄與索引，並做沉澱判斷：這次學到的東西要不要留、用什麼形式留。
skills.en: Mark the task document done, update the changelog and index, and decide what is worth keeping from this task and in what form.

whens.zh: 審查通過，要把文件標完成並更新變更記錄
whens.en: Review passed; mark docs done and update the changelog

whens.zh: 想回顧整個 session 的工作環境
whens.en: You want to review the session's working environment

skills.source: Matt Pocock (MIT), adapted from Humanlayer's show-me
skills.zh: 寫 MR 說明：摘要、前後對照、合併風險。
skills.en: Write the merge-request description: summary, before/after, merge risks.
skills.whenZh: 收尾之後、人工開 MR 之前。
skills.whenEn: After wrap-up, before a person opens the MR.

whens.zh: 收尾完成，要寫 MR 說明給人看
whens.en: Wrap-up is done; write the MR description for reviewers

skills.zh: 背景維護現況文件：架構、功能模組、API、bug 紀錄、widget、變更歷程。
skills.en: Maintain current-state docs in the background: architecture, modules, API, bug records, widgets, change history.
skills.whenEn: When docs lag behind the code.

whens.zh: 架構或 API 文件落後程式碼
whens.en: Architecture or API docs lag behind the code

skills.zh: 跨 AI agent 接力：存狀態、接手、分派、回報、驗收。
skills.en: Hand work across AI agents: save state, resume, delegate, report, review.
skills.whenZh: 額度快用完、要交給其他 agent 時。
skills.whenEn: When quota runs low and another agent takes over.

whens.zh: 額度快用完，要交給別的 agent 接手
whens.en: Quota is running low; another agent should take over

skills.zh: 想被追問、檢驗自己的想法時手動叫用。
skills.en: Invoke manually to stress-test a plan or idea.

whens.zh: 想被追問、檢驗計畫
whens.en: You want a plan interrogated

skills.zh: 回顧這個 session，提出對 agent 工作環境（規則、skill、檢查）的改善建議。
skills.en: Review the session and suggest improvements to the agent's environment (rules, skills, checks).

whens.zh: session 結束，想改善規則與 skill
whens.en: A session ended; improve rules and skills

skills.zh: 寫給 agent 看的文件（skill、AGENTS.md）的規範。
skills.en: Guidelines for documents written for agents (skills, AGENTS.md).
skills.whenZh: 改 skill 或 AGENTS.md 時自動觸發。
skills.whenEn: Triggers when editing skills or AGENTS.md.
skills.shortZh: 給 agent 的文件規範

whens.zh: 要改 skill 或 AGENTS.md
whens.en: Editing a skill or AGENTS.md

skills.zh: 依目標平台產生壓縮指令，排除系統垃圾檔。
skills.en: Generate archive commands for the target platform, excluding OS junk files.

whens.zh: 要壓縮資料夾給別的平台解開
whens.en: Archiving a folder for another platform

skills.zh: 檢查畫面、icon、文案有沒有沒經過選擇的 AI 預設值，逐條寫成立、不成立或沒法判斷。
skills.en: Check screens, icons and copy for unchosen AI defaults; each item is marked holds, does not hold, or cannot tell.

skills.zh: 唯讀的畫面 review：對照 DESIGN.md 與去 AI 味清單，規格、AI 味、使用三軸分開列，不改任何檔案。
skills.en: Read-only screen review against DESIGN.md and the anti-AI-look list, reported on three separate axes; changes no files.

skills.zh: 還沒有 DESIGN.md 時，先把色彩、字型、間距、圓角、元件與 icon 規格定下來。
skills.en: When there is no DESIGN.md yet, settle colors, type, spacing, radius, components and icon specs first.

skills.zh: 用口語描述主題，改寫成多組查詢，到免金鑰的學術來源搜尋並收集論文。
skills.en: Describe a topic in plain language; it rewrites it into queries and collects papers from free academic sources.

skills.zh: 批次處理待整理的素材：摘要、分類加標籤、更新索引與連結。
skills.en: Batch-process raw materials: summarize, classify and tag, then update the index and links.

skills.zh: 用 TBRC 四層框架把單份素材整理成結構化筆記，並評估資產價值。
skills.en: Structure one source into a four-layer TBRC note and score its asset value.

skills.zh: 把同主題的多篇筆記合成一篇高密度精粹（共識、角度、缺口、精華）。
skills.en: Distill several notes on one topic into a dense synthesis: consensus, angles, voids, essence.

skills.zh: 從精粹條目往上提煉：跨來源合成、一句話洞察、跨主題概念框架。
skills.en: Elevate syntheses: cross-source patterns, one-line insights, cross-topic concept frameworks.

skills.zh: 找出放錯條目的補充段落，建議搬到哪裡。
skills.en: Find supplementary paragraphs filed under the wrong entry and suggest where they belong.

skills.zh: 查驗引用頁碼是否落在原文範圍內，以及每個論點是否真的被引用頁支撐。
skills.en: Check that cited page numbers exist in the source and that each claim is supported by the cited page.

skills.zh: 每月巡檢知識庫：筆記間矛盾、無據論點、缺連結、過時內容、知識缺口。
skills.en: Monthly knowledge-base check: contradictions, unsupported claims, missing links, stale content, gaps.

skills.zh: 掃描知識庫產出每日簡報：待處理素材、更新、統計與建議行動。
skills.en: Scan the knowledge base for a daily brief: pending materials, updates, stats and next actions.

skills.zh: 與 Google NotebookLM 雙向橋接：上傳素材、語意問答並取回含頁碼的引用。
skills.en: Bridge to Google NotebookLM: upload sources, ask questions, get citations with page numbers.

skills.zh: 論文定稿後，把方法決策、回覆審查意見等經驗回流進知識庫。
skills.en: After a paper is final, feed methodology decisions and reviewer responses back into the knowledge base.

skills.zh: 把精粹條目匯出成論文寫作工具可用的文獻回顧素材。
skills.en: Export syntheses as literature-review seeds for academic writing tools.

skills.zh: 開放式研究腦力激盪：跨領域連結、挑戰假設、找研究缺口。
skills.en: Open-ended research brainstorming: cross-disciplinary links, challenged assumptions, research gaps.

skills.zh: 把 Obsidian 知識庫當成會自我改寫的第二大腦來讀寫與維護。
skills.en: Read, write and maintain an Obsidian vault as a self-rewriting second brain.

skills.zh: 把課本、投影片、講義、影片字幕收進素材區，自動分區、轉檔、命名。
skills.en: Ingest textbooks, slides, handouts and video captions; sort, convert and name them automatically.

skills.zh: 學生個資與著作權閘門：入庫前去識別化、上傳前驗證白名單，違反就停下。
skills.en: Student-privacy and copyright gate: de-identify before ingest, whitelist before upload, stop on violation.

skills.zh: 把單份教材整理成逆向設計的單元條目（目標、診斷、評量、計畫）。
skills.en: Turn one source into a backward-design unit entry: objective, diagnosis, evidence, plan.

skills.zh: 把同一概念的多個教材來源合成一篇教學版精粹。
skills.en: Synthesize several sources on one concept into a teaching-oriented summary.

skills.zh: 單元條目變成可直接上課的教案：時間分配、指令、鷹架、備案，並排入已知學生迷思。
skills.en: Turn a unit entry into a ready-to-teach lesson plan, with timing, scaffolds, fallbacks and known misconceptions.

skills.zh: 教案轉成投影片（Marp），一張一個訊息，附講者備忘稿。
skills.en: Turn a lesson plan into slides (Marp), one message per slide, with speaker notes.

skills.zh: 先建雙向細目表再出題，每題附答案與評分要點，誘答選項對應真實迷思。
skills.en: Build a test blueprint first, then write items with answers; distractors map to real misconceptions.

skills.zh: 建立四級評分規準，每個面向對應學習目標，拒絕模糊用詞。
skills.en: Build a four-level rubric tied to learning objectives, rejecting vague wording.

skills.zh: 檢查學習目標、教學活動、評量三方是否一致。
skills.en: Check that objectives, activities and assessment line up.

skills.zh: 依評分規準寫學生回饋初稿，必須經教師審核才可匯出，不產出分數。
skills.en: Draft student feedback from a rubric; teacher review is required before export; no grades.

skills.zh: 從學生作答找出反覆出現的迷思，跨學期累積並提出教法檢討。
skills.en: Mine recurring misconceptions from student work, accumulate them across terms, suggest teaching changes.

skills.zh: 把上完課的真實經驗回寫進單元條目，讓下一輪備課直接受益。
skills.en: Write real classroom outcomes back into unit entries so the next round benefits.

skills.zh: 繁體中文去 AI 味改寫，依產出類型套用不同規則。
skills.en: Rewrite Traditional Chinese text to remove AI tone, with rules per output type.

skills.zh: 每學期課程健檢：涵蓋率、空白單元、缺評分規準、對齊與教材過期。
skills.en: Per-term course check: coverage, empty units, missing rubrics, alignment, outdated materials.

skills.zh: 找出上游教材已更新、但下游教案或投影片還沒重新產生的檔案。
skills.en: Find lesson plans or slides that are stale because their source material changed.

skills.zh: 覆寫檔案前自動留快照並依保留策略清理，不依賴 git。
skills.en: Snapshot files before overwriting and prune by retention policy, without git.

skills.zh: 每週備課簡報：本週要教什麼、教材進度、待改作業、待審回饋。
skills.en: Weekly teaching brief: what to teach, material status, grading and feedback to review.

skills.zh: 把教材送進 NotebookLM 問答並取回含頁碼的引用，上傳前先過隱私閘門。
skills.en: Send course materials to NotebookLM for Q&A with page citations, after the privacy gate.

skills.zh: 需要套校方 Office 模板或追蹤修訂時，輸出 pptx、docx、xlsx。
skills.en: Export pptx, docx or xlsx with school templates or tracked changes when required.
